title: Putting Grogu's Reflexes to the Test
description: When Luke Skywalker first boarded the Millennium Falcon, Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi helped Luke hone his skills with the use of a training remote. The remote would attack Luke with bolts, offering him an opportunity to reflexively respond and tap deeper into the Force. Taking a page from his master's book, Luke applies the same approach with Grogu.
